_comment: The speech slot's engine and voices (BYOK: the key is read from the environment variable named here, never stored). One engine voice per speaker, so each tier has its own; `say { voice: "twin" }` picks it. Both voices below are ElevenLabs identifiers given on 2026-09-20. The station is the on-board AI the demo embodies: it reads the messages from Earth, the model's proposals, the twin's answers, the board's refusals; the agent speaks with the same voice.
